thread:
tanvi: Heads-up: preflight for v3.8.0 is starting in the 11pm-1am change window. Deploybot preflight flags needed for EU edge traffic.
deploy-bot: Preflight started for release v3.8.0 (canary -> 1% -> 5% pipeline). Running healthchecks. 
sam: want to confirm change window — traffic will hit eu-west at 23:05, right?
tanvi: yes, that's the plan. ops asked for quiet window from 23:00-00:30.
kevin: noticed a simultaneous infra migration at 23:10 on the eu-west shard. we should avoid overlap. can we shift to 23:40?
maria: shifting to 23:40 is fine for product side, but CI artifact promotion needs to wait 30m.
luca-oncall: if we shift, I need to bump the canary hold to 10m and re-run warmups. also will circle up with infra.
release-bot: Note: artifact hash abc123 -> v3.8.0 built at 2024-09-12T20:48Z. Smoke tests: PASS. Canary config: 1% for 10m -> 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m.
sam: my call: move the start to 23:40, keep the staged targets but extend canary to 15m at 1% before 5%.
tanvi: ack. please post the exact promote command when ready.
kevin: infra says they can delay migration to 00:15 if we start at 23:40. that's safe margin.
maria: ops: any objections? @luca-oncall ?
luca-oncall: no objections, just want the extra canary minute buffer. Also set fallback policy to immediate rollback on >1.5% 5xx rate or kv-cache OOM.
deploy-bot: Preflight results: eu-west tail latency within baseline, but 2 small 502 spikes observed in synthetic at 2:12. Marking as INFO.
sam: hmm re: 502s — could be transient. recommend hold at 1% and do a manual traffic probe after 5m.
kevin: agree. can we pin the previous build as a quick rollback target?
tanvi: yes, pin v3.7.9 as rollback target.
release-bot: Pin recorded: rollback_target=v3.7.9 by tanvi.
maria: Ops wants the release notes updated: add note about tokenizer minor change and fallback heuristics. I pushed a patch to the PR.
sam: ok preparing the promote. command: ```releasebot promote --artifact abc123 --to 1% --duration 15m --pin v3.7.9 --change-window 23:40-00:30```
kevin: LGTM. I'll monitor infra metrics and jump if error budget spikes.
luca-oncall: oncall monitoring: setting up dash and routing alert to #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: Alert hook created: canary-ship-v3-8-0 -> #eng-oncall. Thresholds: 5xx > 1.5%, p95 latency +30%.
release-bot: Ticket: RL-4512 created for rollout. Release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/RL-4512 
tanvi: starting the promote now. everyone standby.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: pushing canary to 1% across eu-west edges.
(deploybot logs)
```
deploy-bot: rollout-step: canary -> 1% success. healthchecks OK.
sam: running the manual probe now: `curl -I https://eu-edge.redwood/api/health` -> all 200s.
kevin: infra traces look clean. no increase in OOMs.
luca-oncall: probe results look good. hold for canary duration.
(twelve minutes later)
deploy-bot: healthcheck: slight uptick in model decode latency p95 +12%. still within SLO. 5xx unchanged.
maria: continuity check — no upstream schema changes. logs show a handful tokenization warnings but no errors.
sam: i vote proceed to 5%. +1 from product.
kevin: +1 infra.
luca-oncall: +1 oncall, roll to 5% when ready.
tanvi: rolling to 5% now.
release-bot: rolling to 5% scheduled. Guardrails still active.
deploy-bot: rollout-step: 5% -> started.
(deploybot logs)
```
deploy-bot: rollout-step: 5% success. healthchecks GREEN. p95 latency normal.
sam: letting it run the 15m window, will re-evaluate at +10m.
(5 minutes left)
deploy-bot: anomaly detected: eu-edge cluster eu-west-2 spike in 502s to 2.1% over 2m window. Triggering ops ticket.
kevin: i'm seeing a correlation with an infra GC pause on a subset of nodes. investigating.
luca-oncall: recommend PAUSE. revert to 1% and hold while infra mitigates.
tanvi: PAUSE. issuing rollback to pinned v3.7.9 at 5%.
release-bot: Rollback command: ```releasebot rollback --to v3.7.9 --scope eu-west --from 5% --reason "502 spike"```
deploy-bot: Rollback started: demoting v3.8.0 traffic in eu-west back to v3.7.9.
(deploybot logs)
```
deploy-bot: rollback complete for eu-west: traffic restored to v3.7.9. Healthchecks returning to baseline.
kevin: infra fixed GC scheduling on problematic nodes. will watch for 10m.
maria: updating release notes and RL-4512 with rollback and root-cause.
sam: quick retro: we should add a preflight synthetic that simulates GC-heavy traffic pattern.
tanvi: agreed. @kevin can you add to infra preflight checklist?
kevin: will do. planning a small change to warmup script to force smoother GC.
luca-oncall: postmortem ping — I'll own the incident doc. adding owners.
tanvi: thanks all. we'll retarget v3.8.0 for next change window after infra patch. :thumbsup:
